pages.title: The 3-Layer System
pages.text: Pick three layers, in order:$(br)$(bold)1. Origin$(): your species, with flavor powers like flight, wall-climbing or fire immunity. {{layer origin count}} options: $(l:icraft:classes/origins_reference)The {{layer origin count}} Origins$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)2. Race$(): your people, with stat modifiers and thematic traits. {{layer race count}} options. $(warn)Permanent.$()$(br2)$(bold)3. Class$(): your combat role. {{layer class count}} options; respec at a Class Altar.

pages.title: What to Pick If...
pages.text: $(bold)Want to hit things:$()$(br)$(thing)Berserker$() (axes, low-HP rage), $(thing)Samurai$() (katanas + bows), $(thing)Orc$() race$(br2)$(bold)Want to cast spells:$()$(br)$(thing)Archmage$() (glass cannon), $(thing)Battlemage$() (melee+magic), $(thing)Elemental$(), $(thing)Blessed$(), $(thing)Corrupted$(), $(thing)Faefolk$() race$(br2)$(bold)Want to tank:$()$(br)$(thing)Vanguard$() (pure tank, -30% melee damage), $(thing)Paladin$() (tank+support+heals), $(thing)Dwarf$() race

pages.title: What to Pick If... (2)
pages.text: $(bold)Want to explore:$()$(br)$(thing)Wanderer$() (jack of all trades), $(thing)Ranger$() (fast, mobile), $(thing)Elf$() race$(br2)$(bold)Want to build/craft:$()$(br)$(thing)Artificer$() class, $(thing)Dwarf$() or $(thing)Halfling$() race$(br2)$(bold)Want to summon:$()$(br)$(thing)Void Summoner$() class, $(thing)Revenant$() race$(br2)$(bold)Don't know yet:$()$(br)$(thing)Wanderer$() class + $(thing)Human$() race: no penalties, bonus XP. Respec once you know your playstyle.

pages.title: Proven Combos
pages.text: $(bold)Blazeborn + Dwarf + Berserker$()$(br)Fire synergy: the Nether becomes trivial.$(br2)$(bold)Elytrian + Elf + Ranger$()$(br)Maximum mobility: fly, kite and never get hit.$(br2)$(bold)Enderian + Faefolk + Archmage$()$(br)Teleport and cast from range. A glass-cannon nuke.

pages.title: Proven Combos, cont.
pages.text: $(bold)Witch of Ink + Orc + Berserker$()$(br)Weak early, a monster late: melee that hyperscales.$(br2)$(italic)Remember: race is permanent, class can be changed. When in doubt, Human + Wanderer.$()

pages.title: Starting with Magic
pages.text: Magic starts at $(t1)Tier 1$().$(br2)$(bold)Iron's Spells & Spellbooks$(): craft a Copper Spell Book early (the pack's $(l:icraft:mods_t1/modular_spells)Modular variants$(/l) take upgrade pages). Inscribe spell scrolls from dungeon chests to learn them.$(br2)$(bold)Botania$(): also $(t1)Tier 1$(). Mana flowers, mana pools, botanical tools.$(br2)$(bold)Ars Nouveau$(): $(t2)Tier 2$(). Custom spell crafting with glyphs.

pages.title: Your First Gear
pages.text: $(bold)Apotheosis Affixes$(): mob drops roll random affixes and gem sockets. Kill $(thing)Apotheosis bosses$() (glowing mobs) for the best early gear.$(br2)$(bold)Tetra Workbench$(): craft one to customize weapons and tools, swapping handles, blades and guards by material.

pages.title: Your First Gear, cont.
pages.text: $(bold)Food Diversity$(): Spice of Life pays permanent max-HP bonuses for eating widely. It is free health, so collect food as you loot.$(br2)$(bold)Next: read $(l:icraft:welcome/three_commands)The Three Commands$(/l).$()
